mappings.query_proposal: query ProductMapping($first:Int!,$offset:Int!){supply_product_versions(first:$first,offset:$offset,orderBy:"product_id"){base_data { category delivery_time description ean manufacturer manufacturer_nr name quantity_min supplier_id supply_catalog { name } unit_type } base_price is_deleted list_price nr product_id sales_prices { net_price_per_unit supply_sales_price { is_default } } supply_operator { name }}}

configurable_templates.query_proposal: query DirectHeroServices($first: Int!, $offset: Int!) { supply_services(first: $first, offset: $offset, orderBy: "id") { company_id created description ean id internal_identifier is_deleted is_fixed_net_price manufacturer modified name net_price_per_unit nr quantity time_minutes unit_type vat_percent } }

query DirectHeroDocuments($first: Int!, $offset: Int!) { FileUpload_FileUploads(first: $first, offset: $offset, sortings: [ID_ASC]) { edges { node { category created downloadUrl filename id modified size uuid } } } }

query DirectHeroPictures($first: Int!, $offset: Int!) { FileUpload_FileUploads(first: $first, offset: $offset, sortings: [ID_ASC], filters: { category: { equals: "images" } }) { edges { node { category created downloadUrl filename id modified size uuid } } } }
query DirectHeroEmployees { company { partners { account_type email first_name full_name id last_name mobile phone role status user { created email id last_login locale modified role } user_id } } }
